subject: What was General Grant doing on the thermostat? (meme)
query: what was general grant doing on the thermostat
title: What was General Grant doing on the thermostat? The meme, explained
answer: "What was General Grant doing on the thermostat?" is a line from the 2011 movie Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Rodrick Rules that became a TikTok trend in November 2026. Dad Frank Heffley finds one of his Civil War figurines, General Ulysses S. Grant, on the thermostat and angrily asks his sons how it got there. On TikTok, people put a small toy on their own thermostat and post it with the line.
body:
The scene: Frank Heffley (played by Steve Zahn), the father in the Wimpy Kid movies, collects Civil War figurines that his kids are not allowed to touch. He discovers the tiny Grant figure sitting on top of the wall thermostat and demands to know who put it there. The boys deny everything, and his exasperated question became a quotable line among fans who grew up with the films. Clips of the scene have circulated on YouTube and TikTok for years.

The new trend started in mid-November 2026. Know Your Meme traces it to a TikTok posted Nov. 14 that put an anime character figure on a thermostat, and within days copies were everywhere: cartoon ponies, plush cats and other small toys perched on thermostats, often with a red circle drawn around them and the line as the caption or audio. Several of the early videos passed 150,000 views in their first days, and one passed half a million. Know Your Meme added an entry on Nov. 18.

How people use it: the joke is the mismatch between a tiny, harmless object and a parent's huge reaction. You might see a post like "Who left the rubber duck on the thermostat??" or a family member asking "What was General Grant doing on the thermostat?" when they find something out of place. It works as a reply whenever something ends up where it obviously should not be.

For parents: the trend is harmless and family-friendly in its original form — it comes from a PG-rated kids' movie. The only practical note is that thermostats are not shelves, so it is better to set a toy on top for a photo and take it down again.
in_the_news: The 2011 Wimpy Kid line resurfaced as a TikTok trend in mid-November 2026, with people placing toys on thermostats; Know Your Meme catalogued it on Nov. 18.

faq.q: What movie is "What was General Grant doing on the thermostat?" from?
faq.a: Diary of a Wimpy Kid: Rodrick Rules (2011), based on Jeff Kinney's second Wimpy Kid book.
Frank Heffley, Greg's dad, played by Steve Zahn, after finding one of his Civil War figurines on the thermostat.
Ulysses S. Grant, the Union Army's top general in the Civil War and later the 18th U.S. president. In the movie he is a small collectible figure.

faq.q: How do you do the thermostat trend?
faq.a: Place a small toy or figure on top of your thermostat, take a photo or short video, and caption it with the line or use the movie audio. Many people add a red circle around the toy.
